convention.coordinate: ancilla g1^a g2^b (anc0) has coordinate (a, b) in Z12 x Z12
convention.shift: edge (check at x, round r) -- (error at position t, home h): offset = r - h, shift = t - x
convention.base_edge: edge = image under g = x of base edge (check (0,0), round r) -- (error type placed at position = shift)
convention.error_position: t chosen so the column's set {(offset, shift)} is lexicographically smallest
